---
title: "Resources"
description: "External guidance and tools that support GeoEpi work."
---

These links are useful starting points, not a policy catalog. Check the source page, current version, license, access conditions, and fit for your project before relying on a resource.

## Data management

- [USDA National Agricultural Library: Data Management Planning](https://www.nal.usda.gov/services/data-management-planning) — primary conceptual source for the six-part project DMP structure used in this Lab Book.
- [ICPSR: Share & Manage Data](https://www.icpsr.umich.edu/sites/icpsr/manage-data) — secondary practical guidance on managing, documenting, sharing, and preserving research data.
- [Ag Data Commons](https://agdatacommons.nal.usda.gov/) — a USDA data discovery and repository resource where appropriate.

## GeoEpi tools and working systems

- [SCINet](https://scinet.usda.gov/) — USDA scientific computing and storage context, including Atlas and Ceres.
- [GitHub](https://github.com/geoepi) — GeoEpi organization and subproject repositories.
- [Quarto](https://quarto.org/) — reproducible reports, websites, notebooks, and technical documentation.
- [Overleaf](https://www.overleaf.com/) — collaborative LaTeX documents and manuscripts.
- [Zotero](https://www.zotero.org/) — shared literature management.
- [OSF](https://osf.io/) — collaborator-accessible research objects and project resources where appropriate.

The [GeoEpi tools page](../tools/index.qmd) explains the role of each system and the boundaries between them.

## Online guides for analytical work

These online books, manuals, and course materials are useful references for analytical work commonly encountered in GeoEpi. They are learning resources, not prescribed methods; use the approach appropriate to the scientific question and data.

### Ecology, population biology, and forecasting

- [Primer of Ecology](https://hankstevens.github.io/Primer-of-Ecology/index.html) - ecological modeling and quantitative population concepts.
- [Quantitative Biology](https://www.quantitative-biology.ca/) - quantitative biology concepts and worked examples.
- [A Practical Guide to Ecosystem Forecasting](https://frec-5174c.github.io/eco4cast-in-R-book/) - ecological forecasting workflows.

### Spatial analysis and geocomputation

- [Spatial Data Science](https://keen-swartz-3146c.netlify.app/) - spatial analysis workflows and concepts.
- [R | Intro to GIS and Spatial Analysis](https://mgimond.github.io/Spatial/coordinate-systems-in-r.html) - introductory GIS and spatial analysis in R.
- [Spatial Data Processing with R](https://jguelat.github.io/spatial-r/) - spatial data processing workflows in R.
- [Geocomputation with R](https://r.geocompx.org/) - geocomputation and spatial data science in R.

### Statistics and comparative methods

- [Rethinking](https://xcelab.net/rm/statistical-rethinking/) - Bayesian statistical modeling and model reasoning.
- [Comparative Methods](https://bookdown.org/bomeara/comparative-methods/) - comparative methods and phylogenetic analysis concepts.

### Population, landscape, and computational genetics

- [Landscape Genetic Data Analysis with R](https://bookdown.org/hhwagner1/LandGenCourse_book/) - population and landscape genetic analysis.
- [Applied Population Genetics](https://dyerlab.github.io/applied_population_genetics/index.html) - applied population genetics workflows.
- [Molecular Epi in R](https://gtpb.github.io/MEVR16/index.html) - molecular epidemiology analysis in R.
- [ComputationalGenomicsManual](https://linsalrob.github.io/ComputationalGenomicsManual/) - computational genomics methods and implementation.

### Epidemiology

- [The Epidemiologist R Handbook](https://epirhandbook.com/en/index.html) - applied epidemiological analysis in R.

### Network analysis

- [Network Analysis in R](https://yunranchen.github.io/intro-net-r/index.html) - network methods and implementation in R.
- [Network Analysis: Integrating Social Network Theory, Method, and Application with R](https://inarwhal.github.io/NetworkAnalysisR-book/) - network theory and applied analysis in R.
